cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

mechanism: A authorizes ever-larger reciprocations so a helpful friend cannot remain ahead in practical sacrifice.
confusable: D19 turns differences into contests; D43 specifically answers favors with bigger favors, and the Stance must retain authority over what repayment is allowed.
comparison: Meal care expands into food and freezer provision; the other alternative shift cover escalates into canceling travel for another person leave.
seedUse: Use D43-a full freezer and returned-tubs request, with S01 approval turning modest requested repayment into a larger authorized sacrifice.
